name: Item2Art (formerly Art2Life)
tagline: Tap an NFC chip on an object to replay the memory it holds as generated music, an image or a voice conversation.

awards: Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: The team, travelling from Spain, wanted to keep memories attached to real objects.
solution: Write a short story, choose music (Suno), an image (Gemini) or a voice conversation (ElevenLabs and Gemini), and link it to an NFC chip through a Flutter app.
demo_moment: Team-described: tap an object and hear its song.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry” among 160 submissions.
Links generated media to physical keepsakes.

lessons: Attach the digital to a physical object people already treasure.
